h1: Concrete & Site Work in Scranton and Lackawanna County
subtitle: Affordable housing, a $1.8 million park revitalization, and a veterans memorial in Scranton and Dickson City.
intro: Our work in the Scranton area includes Hilltop Heights, a City of Scranton housing initiative for developer Quandell Construction; the $1.8 million revitalization of the former Penn Ridge pool site into Capouse Avenue Park in the Pine Brook neighborhood; and a veterans memorial plaza for Dickson City Borough.
Those projects drew on our site work and concrete crews. For paving, which we do across the region, see our paving page.
cta_heading: Planning a Project in the Scranton Area?
cta_text: Tell us about the site and we'll get back to you within one business day.
